      public static final IExpr.ISymbol FLOAT16
      Short names for common FloatingPoint sorts (FloatingPoint.smt2's :notes documents each as a synonym for a specific (_ FloatingPoint eb sb) instance) -- resolved by SymbolTable.lookupSort() to the exact same ISort.IDefinition as that instance, not registered as their own independent sorts (see Utils.loadTheory(), which excludes them from the generic :sorts loader for the same reason).
